topic: Verify the lumo.md Reasonix vs Pi prompt-caching claims and scope feasibility of a Reasonix-style Pi caching plugin

findings.verdict: overstated; DeepSeek-native but README describes OpenAI-compatible configuration

findings.claim: Pi has universal built-in prompt caching
findings.verdict: partially supported only as provider-directed cache-control compatibility
confirmed as an installable Pi package; not proven bundled/core from the listing

findings.claim: Pi cache content shares automatically among concurrent agents
findings.verdict: not substantiated by the primary package documentation reviewed
not substantiated by primary sources reviewed
partly false: session tree/fork/clone exists; workspace rollback was not verified

findings.claim: Pi cannot host Reasonix-like workflow helpers
findings.verdict: false as a capability claim; documented extensions can add commands, tools, UI, and session helpers

findings.claim: A full Reasonix clone is the right plugin scope
findings.verdict: rejected for v1; cache discipline and observability are feasible, while Context Engine, MCP, planning, and workspace snapshots are separate workstreams

scope: controlled baseline versus optimized workload export

openQuestions: Can the chosen provider expose cached versus uncached token counts through Pi's configured route?
